tier_compliance.reason: The hint concludes, 'both samples will have the same temperature,' completing the comparison instead of connecting a visible detail to a concept without deciding the answer.

visual_grounding.reason: Its references to both samples having 'the same number of particles' and 'the same average particle speed' match the depicted particles and the two 1,500 m/s labels and underpin its reasoning.

scientific_correctness.reason: 'The same average particle speed' does not imply the same average kinetic energy when particle masses differ. The image gives 32 u for A and 34 u for B, so B has the higher average kinetic energy and temperature.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: 'Both samples will have the same temperature' directs the student to option B, whereas the gold answer is option C, sample B.

answer_disclosure.reason: 'Both samples will have the same temperature' directly states the conclusion corresponding to an answer option, albeit the wrong one.

actionability.reason: The hint supplies an erroneous completed comparison and conclusion without giving the student a usable next action.
